name: GridStatus.io
tagline: US ISO/RTO electricity market data unified HTTP API.
description: Unified HTTP API for US ISO/RTO electricity market data including prices, load, and generation. Accuracy matters more than completeness — a wrong fact is far worse than "unknown".

auth.details: API key via X-Api-Key header, self-serve signup

use_cases: get current electricity prices for an ISO
fetch historical load data for a region
